{{Top|leg}}
'''Lacas''' were herd animals native to [[Makthierse]]. Massing around 300 kilograms, they were the prey of [[preying makthier]]s. They were also raised on ranches by sapient locals.<ref name="COG">''[[Creatures of the Galaxy]]''</ref>
